name: Daniel Sayre

events.title: Will
events.description: Names children Joseph, Daniel, Hannah (wife of Mr Josiah Topping), deceased son Samuel's children, David, Ephraim and Nathan (executor); son-in-law Josiah Topping to sell two slaves, Gordg and Moll; the woman to choose her own master.

bioAdditions: His will (Banta, S1; recorded N.Y. Liber 7, folio 480) is the document that shows his daughter Hannah married Josiah Topping and had no daughter Jerusha. A humane touch: he asked that his enslaved woman 'may have Liberty to chuse her master when she is sold' and keep her clothes and box.

sources.citation: T. M. Banta, Sayre Family (1901) (archive.org full text), pp. 29-30
sources.supports: Full text of Daniel Sayre's will 1707
